pins.title: Be bold, start cold
pins.sub: Comfy at the trailhead? You'll be sweating 10 minutes into the climb. Start a little chilly, fleece in your pack.

pins.title: Skip the jeans
pins.sub: Cotton soaks up sweat and rain and stays cold. Pick quick-dry nylon or polyester with a little stretch.

pins.title: 7 guides, one gift
items: What To Do If You Get Lost
pins.sub: The Ultimate Hiker's Toolkit. Instant download, print it or read it on a phone.

pins.title: Pick a turnaround time
pins.sub: Check today's sunset, decide when you turn back no matter what, and carry a headlamp.
